name: xingchi-session-keeper
description: magpie gateway middleware: auto-compress conversation turns and rotate sessions when a provider hits its per-session turn/request limit

summary.en: Auto-compress old conversation turns and rotate the session when a provider caps turns/requests per session (e.g. XingChi 100 turns). Works on top of providers you already use; no separate sign-in.
summary.zh: 供应商按会话限制轮次/请求数（如 XingChi 每会话 100 轮）时自动压缩旧对话并换会话继续，挂在你已有的供应商上用，无需额外登录。
